source.source_split: already consumed F3 CAL ONLY; 64 equal-weight worlds and pre-write events starting t=2; no new split

trained_dynamics.architecture: DiagonalContinuousSSM 256-float recurrent hidden state, learned 33→256 input projection, 272→16 head

hypothesis.mechanism: add a learned/fixed factual residual memory W (16x16) on TOP OF frozen SSM read-before-write prediction. Before observing y[t], ssm_hat=original SSM head([ssm_state,a[t]]) and residual_hat=W@a[t], final_hat=ssm_hat+residual_hat. After y[t] is observed, write residual_target=y[t]-ssm_hat using original three-coefficient P78 or selected fixed eta=.4 update; then advance original SSM state with original [a[t],y[t],1] event. No y[t] in current readout.
hypothesis.state_budget: ssm256 plus residual256 = 512 floats/world; compare against unchanged trained SSM256 and SSM256+inert256 control; static parameters SSM unchanged and original frozen 3 scalar P78 coefficients. Never claim matched capacity to unaugmented SSM.
hypothesis.evaluation: mean per-world per-step squared error on four P80 normalized physical delta channels, excluding event 1 and all 9 padded outputs; 64 CAL worlds, all recorded actual actions
hypothesis.primary: every one of 3 original P78 seeds must yield <=0.90x frozen trained SSM MSE AND <=0.95x fixed-residual overlay MSE. Any miss FAIL.
hypothesis.cost: median CPU episode inference+write time for residual <=3x plain frozen SSM when measured same machine no reload; report whole replay wall and RSS, not qualified matched science
hypothesis.negatives: wrong-action credit harms changed residual estimate; original SSM numerical parity without residual; mid-episode cold restore of BOTH 256-float states; first-effect future target cannot change before-write predicted result; no parameter update; no source birth; fail invalid mixed units and nonfinite state

qualification.engineering: existing original SHA G4 Win+Ubuntu full, G5 native both, G7 Ubuntu; source-only toys and exact archive read-back
